about.title: Citizen's Charter 2023
about.legalBasis: Republic Act No. 11032 — Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Services Delivery Act of 2018

what.title: A public promise, in writing
what.text: The Citizen's Charter is the Municipality's official published list of every frontline service it offers. Once a service is in the Charter, the LGU has committed to delivering it exactly as written.

what.title: No surprises at the counter
what.text: Each service states its requirements and where to secure them, the fees, the processing time, the steps on both sides of the counter, and the officer responsible — so you know what to bring and what to expect before you travel to the municipal hall.

what.title: Required by law
what.text: RA 11032 (the Ease of Doing Business Act) obliges every government office to publish and honour a Citizen's Charter, and to re-issue it whenever services change. This is Calatrava's second edition.

what.title: It works both ways
what.text: The Charter also sets out how to give feedback or file a complaint, and how quickly the LGU must respond — feedback is collected at the information help desk and answered within three working days.
